interpretation.requestedResult: Final focus coordinates from the first lens centre, in terms of focal length f and signed transverse displacement d.
stated: Two equal positive thin lenses separated by 3f, with the second axis above the first by d, d much smaller than f. The incident beam is horizontal.
assumptions: Paraxial rays in the branch transmitted by both finite lenses.
unknowns: Absolute focal lengths, displacement, apertures and beam width.
